chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 379: Ji Ning faces the Eastflow Twelve Demon Kings in a deadly ambush gone wrong!
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning sets a trap for the Firewing Demon King, but all twelve of the Eastflow Demon Kings show up! A treasure map from the fallen Qi Kingdom changes everything in this high-stakes Xianxia chapter.
og_title: 🚨 Ambush FAIL! Ji Ning baits a demon king, reels in TWELVE!
og_description: The Eastflow Twelve Demon Kings gather for a treasure, then decide to hunt down the Qi remnants personally. Ji Ning expected one enemy… he got an army. #DesolateEra #Xianxia #Oops
twitter_title: Ji Ning goes fishing for one demon king… catches a whole school of predators! 🦈🐉🔥
twitter_description: The calm before the storm as Ji Ning faces the entire Eastflow Twelve Demon Kings after a successful bait! This chapter is pure tension.

lore_anchors.definition: A coalition of twelve of the most powerful, ruthless demon kings in the Star Continent. They are so strong that even Celestial Immortals are wary of opposing them.
A member of the Eastflow Twelve and the one who orchestrated the destruction of the Kingdom of Qi. He is the main target of Ji Ning's current hunting trip.
A former kingdom that was recently destroyed by the Firewing Demon King. Its remnants, including the royal family, are now under Ji Ning's protection.

A cultivator who has transcended mortality but whose fleshly body has been destroyed during their tribulation, forcing them to live on in their Primal/Nascent Soul form. They are powerful but face periodic tribulations.
An elite corps of soldiers under the command of the Firewing Demon King, highly trained in Dao-soldier formations.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, so pure it can be absorbed instantly without burdening the body. It is a legendary cultivation resource and high-value currency among cultivators.
The sixth major realm of Ki Refining in the Desolate Era system, following the Primal stage. It is a crucial step towards becoming a Celestial Immortal.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining. A cultivator at this stage sees their internal world develop stars, a moon, and a sun, granting them incredibly fast energy absorption.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did all twelve demon kings show up?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They were already gathered to plan a treasure hunt. When news of the ambush came, they decided to act as a united front, both for brotherhood and out of curiosity about the threat.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Ji Ning going to die?
cultural_notes_faq.a: This is a Xianxia novel. The protagonist rarely dies, especially not to random side villains. This is a test of his adaptability and a huge power-check for the reader.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the secret treasure map about?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It leads to a massively dangerous and ancient treasure ground that even the Eastflow Twelve are scared of. It holds techniques and treasures that can elevate them to the Celestial Immortal level and beyond.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Firewing King destroy the Qi Kingdom?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He did it specifically to obtain this treasure map and the secrets of the treasure ground that the Qi royal family was guarding.
